specimen.label: Без аниматор · 1

screens.label: Operations day
screens.requirement: The owner moves each booking through scheduling and animator assignment.

screens.label: Order inbox
screens.requirement: Site orders arrive in one inbox.

screens.label: Booking
screens.requirement: Owner and animator can see when a deposit is missing, with a clear red warning. The owner marks a deposit received.

screens.label: Leave requests
screens.requirement: Animators request leave; the owner approves it.

screens.label: Customers
screens.requirement: The owner can find customer history, repeat families, large orders, and upcoming birthdays.

screens.label: My parties
screens.requirement: Each animator sees correct party times and a usable address.

screens.label: Request leave
screens.requirement: Animators request leave; the owner approves it.

screens.label: My pay
screens.requirement: Animators can see their own pay so month end checking takes less manual work.

statusMeaning.danger: Only a missing deposit. Nothing else on any screen may be solid red.
statusMeaning.warning: An animator clash, an unassigned party, or leave that needs cover.

references.title: Week schedule by area
references.note: Row per person; status sits inside each shift block.

references.title: Week schedule with conflicts
references.note: Conflict and overtime counts are pinned in the toolbar, not hidden in rows.

references.title: Day view, staff as columns
references.note: Three facts per block; empty time stays visible as white space.

references.title: Week view with overlaps
references.note: Overlapping appointments split the column instead of covering each other.

references.title: Day calendar
references.note: A single strong accent marks the current entry on a quiet grid.
